questions.topic: eGurukul · Forensic Medicine - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stemHtml: Image of the side of a deceased male was given, Identify the postmortem change:
questions.solutionHtml:
Marbling

The post mortem sign shown is marbling which is an external sign of putrefaction. In marbling, the superficial veins are stained purplish red or greenish brown in a branching pattern. It is usually seen 36-48 hours after death and occurs due to the formation of sulfhemoglobin.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 155, 165, 334

questions.topic: eGurukul · Forensic Medicine - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stem: Worker in matchstick factory present with multiple discharge from sinuses on jaw. Which of the following is the likely poisoning?
questions.solutionHtml:
Phosphorus
  • The above mentioned case is suggestive of chronic phosphorus poisoning.
  • The patient has a phossy jaw, which refers to osteomyelitis and necrosis of jaw and foul smelling pus discharge and multiple sinuses.
  • Initially, this condition presents with toothache, followed by jaw swelling, loosening of teeth. Later on this progresses to osteomyelitis .


KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 81, 320, 549

questions.topic: eGurukul · Forensic Medicine - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stem: Hooch tragedy was due to consumption of which of the following?
questions.solutionHtml:
Methyl alcohol
  • The Hooch tragedy was due to consumption of wood alcohol( methanol). Signs and symptoms are due to accumulation of formic acid, the end metabolite of methanol. These include severe metabolic acidosis and blindness.
  • Management includes ethanol, bicarbonate, 4-methyl pyrazole, folinic acid and hemodialysis.


KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 154

questions.stem: Tattooing in the case of a gunshot wound, is it due to?
questions.solutionHtml:
Unburned gunpowder

Tattooing is caused by the impact of partially burned or unburned gunpowder particles on the victim's skin, causing Tattooing of dermis layer

(cannot be washed away)



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number-221-224

questions.topic: eGurukul · Forensic Medicine - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stem: A piece of cloth was submitted by police obtained from a crime scene with some dried stains. On microscopic examination after adding of picric acid solution, yellow needle shaped crystals are seen. This test is done to detect which of the following?
questions.solutionHtml:
Semen
  • Yellow needle crystals are seen in Barberio’s test .
  • The test which the police did is the Barberio’s test, a commonly used test for semen analysis other than Florence test.
  • In a Positive barberios test, the presence of spermine in the seminal sample is giving the yellow coloured needle crystals.


KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 434

questions.topic: eGurukul · Forensic Medicine - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stem: What is the term used to describe the act of a 40-year-old woman who feigned pregnancy, gave birth, and later presented a neighbor's child as her in an attempt to extort him for property advantages?
questions.solutionHtml:
Suppositious child
  • "Supposititious child" is a legal term used to refer to a child who is fraudulently represented as someone else's biological child.
  •  In other words, it is a child who is falsely claimed to be someone else's offspring.
  • This can occur in cases of adoption fraud, where a child is presented as the biological child of the adoptive parents or in cases where a child is falsely claimed to be the biological child of someone else for various reasons such as inheritance or legal benefits.


KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 397
